meta.title: Ondra Emotion Six States
meta.description: Six state names — delighted, soft, calm, wilted, bristling, sleepy — exactly matching the six mood tags shown in the launch film. One judgement drives three surfaces at once: which sentence shape the prompt should use, whether the rhythm should speed up or slow down, and whether speech should be read aloud. Happy means shorter bursts and a lifted ending; tired means one long sentence, finished and quiet; bristling means very short lines, no reading aloud, and no reaching out first. She never prints numbers, she just feels less like talking today.
